subject: Portfolio consolidation: pricing comparison & match proposal
messages:
From: Mira Patel <mira.patel@arcadia.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Tim Wu <tim.wu@arcadia.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Portfolio consolidation — high level ask

Hi Neha,

We spoke to Jordan at the conference last month; Arcadia is evaluating consolidating several ML inference line items across three vendors into a single supplier. Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a consolidated comparison and, importantly, whether you can match list pricing on a subset of our high-volume SKUs for Q4.

Attached is our export of active subscriptions and usage (arcadia_portfolio_export.csv). High level asks:
- A line-item price comparison against our current effective rates (see CSV).
- A firm proposal for a price-match on top 3 SKUs (volume commitments through 2027).
- Any migration credits, onboarding assistance, and estimated timeline for seat migration.

Procurement is targeting a decision window the week of 9/13. Can you confirm whether you can provide a matched commercial in time? If helpful, Tim (CC) can share technical constraints.

Thanks,
Mira
Mira Patel
Head of Cloud Procurement
Arcadia Systems

Attachment: arcadia_portfolio_export.csv (CSV export of active SKUs, seats, historical usage)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Mira Patel <mira.patel@arcadia.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-26T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio consolidation — high level ask

Mira — thanks for the file and the clear asks. We can put together a side-by-side and a commercial match proposal. Quick notes / next steps: 

1) We’ll need a short call (30m) with Tim and your procurement lead to confirm SKU mapping and any contract constraints (term, auto-renew, early-termination liabilities).
2) Commercial framing we’ll prepare:
   - Line-item price match for top 3 SKUs (conditional on 12-month minimum commit by SKU).
   - Phased rebate plan (credits applied over 3 quarters) to offset migration friction.
   - One-time migration credit up to $X for technical handoff and integration testing.
3) Can you confirm whether Arcadia requires SOC2 attestation evidence and any specific privacy clauses for the consolidated contract? We have SOC2 and can surface an evidence packet.

I’m looping Jordan for the rebate mechanics and Rishi for any legal procurement questions. We’ll aim to get a formal PDF proposal and a redline-ready MSA by 9/3 so you have time before procurement interviews.

Proposed call slots (PST): 8/27 9:00–11:00, 8/28 14:00–16:00. Which works for you?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (referenced) arcadia_portfolio_export.csv

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, Mira Patel <mira.patel@arcadia.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-26T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio consolidation — high level ask

Mira / team — following Neha’s note. A couple of commercial levers we’d propose to include in the formal package:

- Price-Match Anchor: we’ll match effective per-token (or seat) rate for top-3 SKUs for first 12 months assuming aggregate commit >= $500k/year.
- Phased Rebate: 10% credit applied in Q1 after cutover, 7.5% in Q2, 5% in Q3 as usage ramps; credits issued against invoice.
- Migration Assistance: up to 25 hours of dedicated solution-engineering support for free + a $30k migration credit for integration/egress costs.
- Technical Fallthrough: where we can’t provide identical feature parity, we’ll provide a fallback SLA with rollback windows and a technical acceptance checklist.

I attached a short PDF with the phased rebate examples and tongue-in-cheek sample math so procurement can validate the model quickly.

Jordan Blake
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment: phased_rebate_options.pdf

From: Mira Patel <mira.patel@arcadia.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Tim Wu <tim.wu@arcadia.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio consolidation — pricing comparison & match proposal

Appreciate the quick replies. A few constraints from procurement/IT:
- Procurement will only consider proposals with a named owner for onboarding and a migration SLA.
- Our fiscal window closes 9/30; we need committed pricing and a statement of work by 9/10 to hit budget cycles.
- We have a vendor-security packet (SOC2 + additional questionnaire) that Tim will share.

Can you send firm numbers (not ranges) for the price-match and the exact credit mechanics? We’d like to circulate that to the buying committee. Also sharing our timeline for context.

Thanks — I can take a 30m call tomorrow morning 8/27 9:30 PST.

Mira

Attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Mira Patel <mira.patel@arcadia.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-26T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portfolio consolidation — pricing comparison & match proposal

Great — thanks Mira. Confirming the 8/27 9:30 PST slot; I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute.

Summary of what we’ll bring to the call / what you can expect in the 9/3 PDF:
- Firm price-match table for top-3 SKUs (per-token and per-seat) with contract language that binds match to the agreed commit level.
- Exact credit mechanics: a $30,000 migration credit applied as an invoice credit within 60 days of go-live; phased rebate credits (10% / 7.5% / 5%) with example calculation included; credits are non-refundable and apply against future invoices.
- Onboarding: named Solutions Engineer (SE) + 25 hours of SE time included, plus a dedicated onboarding manager for 30 days post-cutover.
- Security: we will send SOC2 evidence and a completed vendor questionnaire before the call.

Action items for Arcadia ahead of the call:
1) Confirm the three SKUs you want prioritized for the match (list SKU ids from your CSV).
2) Share procurement lead contact so we can include them in the proposal distribution.

If procurement needs a different credit structure (one-off vs. phased), we can show a second option on the 9/3 doc. Look forward to talking tomorrow.

Cheers,
Neha
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

(Invite: 8/27 09:30 PST — sent)
